title: Agent-as-a-Judge: Evaluate Agents with Agents

defines.name: Agent-as-a-Judge
defines.definition: A framework in which agentic systems are used to evaluate other agentic systems, providing intermediate feedback over the full task-solving process.

defines.name: DevAI
defines.definition: A benchmark of 55 realistic automated AI development tasks with hierarchical user requirements for evaluating agentic code-generation systems.

problem: Existing evaluation methods for agentic systems are too focused on final outcomes or too costly to provide rich intermediate feedback during task solving.
